# TekWise Partners LLC

> TekWise Partners LLC is a Colorado licensed insurance agency. It offers life insurance, annuities and long-term care coverage, and hosts free estate planning workshops in Denver, Colorado, in partnership with Integrated Trust Services and its attorney network. Owner: Evan Frazier.

TekWise Partners does not provide legal or tax advice. Workshops and the Estate Planning Checkup are educational; estate planning documents are prepared by attorneys in the Integrated Trust Services network for clients who choose to enroll.

TekWise Partners is under common ownership (Tetramorph Holdings LLC) with TekWise Financial Planners LLC, a Colorado state-registered investment adviser (https://tekwisefinancial.com), and The Tax Tacticians LLC, a tax planning and preparation firm (https://taxtactician.com).

- [Home](https://tekwisepartners.com/): Services, affiliated companies and contact details
- [Estate Planning](https://tekwisepartners.com/estate-planning.html): Free Denver estate planning workshops, how the process works, the Estate Planning Checkup tool, and FAQs
